title: Effects of Alkoxy Chain Length and 1-Hydroxy Group on Anticolorectal Cancer Activity of 2-Bromoalkoxyanthraquinones.
authors: Mekzali, Nurhaliza Wati; Chee, Cheok Wui; Abdullah, Iskandar; Lee, Yean Kee; Rashid, Nurshamimi Nor; Lee, Vannajan Sanghiran; Othman, Rozana; Hashim, Najihah Mohd; Chee, Chin Fei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究2-溴烷氧基蒽醌类化合物的抗结直肠癌活性，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白（p53/KRAS）而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: KRAS and p53 are two of the most common genetic alterations associated with colorectal cancer. New drug development targeting these mutated genes in colorectal cancer may serve as a potential treatment avenue to the current regimen. OBJECTIVE: The objective of the present study was to investigate the effects of alkoxy chain length and 1-hydroxy group on anticolorectal cancer activity of a series of 2-bromoalkoxyanthraquinones and corroborate it with their in silico properties. METHODS: In vitro anticancer activity of 2-bromoalkoxyanthraquinones was evaluated against HCT116, HT29, and CCD841 CoN cell lines, respectively. Molecular docking was performed to understand the interactions of these compounds with putative p53 and KRAS targets (7B4N and 6P0Z). RESULTS: 2-Bromoalkoxyanthraquinones with the 1-hydroxy group were proven to be more active than the corresponding counterparts in anticancer activity. Among the tested compounds, compound 6b with a C(3) alkoxy chain exhibited the most promising antiproliferation activity against HCT116 cells (IC(50) = 3.83 +/- 0.05 muM) and showed high selectivity for HCT116 over CCD841 CoN cells (SI = 45.47). The molecular docking reveals additional hydrogen bonds between the 1-hydroxy group of 6b and the proteins. Compound 6b has adequate lipophilicity (cLogP = 3.27) and ligand efficiency metrics (LE = 0.34; LLE = 2.15) close to the proposed acceptable range for an initial hit. CONCLUSION: This work highlights the potential of the 1-hydroxy group and short alkoxy chain on anticolorectal cancer activity of 2-bromoalkoxyanthraquinones. Further optimisation may be warranted for compound 6b as a therapeutic agent against colorectal cancer.
abstract_zh: 背景：KRAS和p53是与结直肠癌相关的两种最常见的基因改变。针对结直肠癌中这些突变基因的新药开发可能为当前治疗方案提供潜在的治疗途径。目的：本研究旨在探讨烷氧基链长度和1-羟基基团对一系列2-溴烷氧基蒽醌抗结直肠癌活性的影响，并与其计算机模拟性质进行验证。方法：分别评估2-溴烷氧基蒽醌对HCT116、HT29和CCD841 CoN细胞系的体外抗癌活性。进行分子对接以理解这些化合物与推定p53和KRAS靶标（7B4N和6P0Z）的相互作用。结果：带有1-羟基基团的2-溴烷氧基蒽醌在抗癌活性方面被证明比相应无此基团的化合物更有效。在测试的化合物中，具有C(3)烷氧基链的化合物6b对HCT116细胞表现出最有前景的抗增殖活性（IC(50) = 3.83 ± 0.05 μM），并对HCT116相对于CCD841 CoN细胞显示出高选择性（SI = 45.47）。分子对接揭示了6b的1-羟基基团与蛋白质之间的额外氢键。化合物6b具有足够的亲脂性（cLogP = 3.27）和配体效率指标（LE = 0.34；LLE = 2.15），接近初始命中化合物建议的可接受范围。结论：本研究强调了1-羟基基团和短烷氧基链对2-溴烷氧基蒽醌抗结直肠癌活性的潜在作用。化合物6b作为抗结直肠癌治疗剂可能需要进一步优化。
